A further falsifier is any confirmation run in which the frozen selection changes or in which terminal affinity improves without a corresponding local N/C and geometry response, which would indicate the measured effect is not attributable to the declared local patch. The strongest measured counterexample is the same node's alternative layout evidence: single_b011_final_000 has native_minus_alternate_mean 1.1755 and best_legal_score 8.371298, while single_b011_final_030 has native_minus_alternate_mean 0.0763 and best_legal_score 8.912224, showing that native-minus-alternate mean and best legal score can move in opposite directions, so reduced imitation loss or a higher legal score is not success. This matches the declared intervention: local N/C-evidence patch, geometry alone, to measure the effect of replacing the broad R13 cloud. The patch is the fixed local subset atom_slots [6,8,13,22] with typed_slots [8,22] (slot 8 native C, N_minus_C -0.4136, best donor A:ARG:47:N; slot 22 native N, N_minus_C +0.0763, best donor A:VAL:116:N, teacher_match_strength 0.9511) and orientation neighbors 6 and 13. All direct loss support, including context, remains this proper local subset; atoms outside the patch are not constrained by this selection and no background points are added. Geometry uses distinct spatial assignments frozen within a derivative, never generated atom indices copied from the teacher. Gradients act only on current coordinates through real coordinate Jacobians; affinity is not differentiated, discrete labels are not overridden, the new graph is not fixed, and no SMC is introduced. Terminal N/C labels are not asserted to be chemical identities at a noisy intermediate time; the N preference at slot 22 is a donor-facing geometry proxy against A:VAL:116:N and does not distinguish pyridine N from pyrrole [nH] or amide N, and the C preference at slot 8 is a conditional association with compensating labels elsewhere, not an independent atom energy. Counterfactual layouts are scored label hypotheses on fixed coordinates, not an observed continuation state or a promised score for new molecules. Expected observable changes: under the frozen geometry, slot 22 retains N character and slot 8 retains C character, while orientation neighbors 6 and 13 move under model-mediated gradients within the declared dose (max_atom_step_A 0.15, max_cumulative_rms_A 6.0, native_rms_ratio 0.33, pointcloud_delta_A 1.0) and unit_rms balancing. Final affinity is primary; validity, failure, strain and actual local N/C response must be reported against the frozen incumbent (best_qualified_pic50 8.378002, mean_all_pic50 7.682615, n_above_reference 0, target_pic50 8.704806). Reduced imitation loss alone is not success.
